Question 19
?

The line segment XY― is a diameter of a circle. Given that X and Y have coordinates (−1,−3) and (3,1), respectively, what is the equation of the circle?

a
 (x−1)2+(y−1)2=8
b
 (x−1)2+(y+1)2=32
c
 (x+1)2+(y−1)2=8
d
(x−1)2+(y+1)2=8
e
 (x+1)2+(y−1)2=32
Submit
